raw_response.auditor_note: Tool docstring explicitly promises: 'pass domain to get an explicit not_covered refusal ... instead of relying on silence' when a domain is not swept. Passing a domain string that matches NO real domain in the vocabulary (career/wealth/health/etc, typo or garbage) does NOT trigger that not_covered refusal path — coverage.domains_not_covered stays empty (it is computed independently of the requested domain filter, from the chart's global sweep coverage) and the response instead silently returns an empty windows[] with a generic SQL-style empty_reason, giving no signal that 'nonexistent_domain_xyz' isn't a real domain at all.
